newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices mixed, Punjab arrivals rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices mixed, Punjab arrivals rise.

text.p: Indian cotton prices were mixed on Tuesday with Punjab varieties lower and Gurajat types unchanged, dealers said, after Monday's market holiday.
"New crop arrivals in the Punjab region rose today to 28,000/30,000 bales (170 kg each) against the earlier daily average of 20/25 thousand bales," one dealer said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi slid by 10/20 rupees to 865/900 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned fell by 10 to 1,530/1,640. Gujarat cotton was steady in limited activity.
Gujarat Sankar-4 was quiet at 18,000/18,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) and at 19,000 rupees for the superior variety.
